app.name: KAPSORA
app.soonBody: This screen arrives in a later increment. The menu entry shows the planned structure.

auth.loginIntro: Sign in with your KAPSORA account.
auth.tenantPickerIntro: You are a member of more than one organization. Choose the one to work for in this session.
auth.noTenantsBody: Your account is not active in any tenant. Contact your administrator.
auth.mustChangePassword: You must change your password before continuing.
auth.stepUpIntro: {{action}} needs your password again. The confirmation is valid for a short window.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.intro: Legal entities this tenant has a relationship with: payers, sponsors, providers and vendors.
organizations.emptyHint: Clear the filters or add an organization.

fields.tenantCodeHint: Your own code for this organization; optional.

organizations.identifierHint: For Türkiye a VKN (10 digits) or, for sole traders, a TCKN (11 digits) is required. The server validates and merges duplicates.
organizations.conflictBody: Someone else updated this record while you were editing. The server version and your values are shown below. Reload the latest version and reapply your change; nothing is overwritten silently.
organizations.sharedReadOnly: This organization is shared with other tenants; its display name cannot be changed here.

problems.UNKNOWN: Something unexpected happened. If it persists, contact support with the trace id.
problems.NETWORK_ERROR: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
problems.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session was not found or has expired. Sign in again.
problems.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: User name or password is wrong.
problems.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: The account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts.
problems.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
problems.ETAG_MISMATCH: The record changed while you were editing.
problems.SERVICE_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND: The service category was not found.
problems.SERVICE_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND: The service definition was not found.
problems.CODE_SYSTEM_NOT_FOUND: The code system was not found.
problems.CATEGORY_CODE_TAKEN: That category code is already in use.
problems.SERVICE_DEFINITION_CODE_TAKEN: That service code is already in use.
problems.CODE_SYSTEM_TAKEN: That code system and version is already registered.
problems.CATEGORY_CYCLE: A category cannot be placed inside its own subtree.
problems.CODE_MAPPING_OVERLAP: Another mapping for this code covers an overlapping period.
problems.PROVIDER_PROFILE_EXISTS: This organization already has a provider profile.
problems.PROVIDER_TRANSITION_INVALID: The provider cannot move to that status.
problems.LOCATION_CODE_TAKEN: That location code is already used by this provider.
problems.CAPABILITY_OVERLAP: Another capability for this service covers an overlapping period.
problems.PRACTITIONER_ASSIGNMENT_OVERLAP: Another assignment to this location and role covers an overlapping period.
problems.PRACTITIONER_REGISTRATION_TAKEN: That registration number is already registered with this authority.
problems.PAYMENT_TERM_NOT_FOUND: This version has no payment term yet.
problems.CONTRACT_PARTY_NOT_FOUND: The payer, sponsor or provider was not found.
problems.CONTRACT_CODE_TAKEN: That contract code is already in use.
problems.CONTRACT_TRANSITION_INVALID: The contract cannot move to that status.
problems.CONTRACT_VERSION_IMMUTABLE: A published contract version cannot be changed; open a new version.
problems.CONTRACT_VERSION_OVERLAP: Another published version of this contract covers those dates.
problems.CONTRACT_VERSION_TRANSITION_INVALID: The contract version cannot move to that status.
problems.PRICE_LIST_CODE_TAKEN: That price list code is already used in this version.
problems.PACKAGE_CODE_TAKEN: That package code is already used in this version.
problems.PROVIDER_QUOTA_DUPLICATE: Two quotas cannot share the same scope and period.
problems.PRICE_AMBIGUOUS: Two prices are equally specific, so the system will not choose one. Give the price lists different priorities.
problems.PRICE_NOT_FOUND: No contracted price applies to this service on that date.
problems.RULE_SET_CODE_TAKEN: That rule set code is already used.
problems.RULE_CODE_TAKEN: That rule code is already used in this version.
problems.RULE_PRIORITY_TAKEN: Two rules cannot share a priority; give each rule its own.
problems.RULE_TEST_CASE_CODE_TAKEN: That test case code is already used in this version.
problems.RULE_VERSION_IMMUTABLE: A published rule version cannot be changed; open a new version.
problems.RULE_SET_VERSION_OVERLAP: Another published version of this rule set covers those dates.
problems.RULE_VERSION_TRANSITION_INVALID: The rule version cannot move to that status.
problems.RULE_VERSION_NOT_PUBLISHED: Only a published rule version can record a decision; use simulation for a draft.
problems.PRICE_QUOTE_LOCATION_INVALID: That location does not belong to this provider.
problems.PRICE_QUOTE_ELIGIBILITY_INVALID: That eligibility evaluation is not for this person.
problems.PRICE_QUOTE_RETRY: The data changed while the quote was being priced; send the same request again.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: The service request was not found, or it is not visible in this organization.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_VERSION_NOT_FOUND: That version of the request was not found.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_PROVIDER_SCOPE: You may not act on behalf of this provider.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_DRAFT_MISSING: The request has no editable version. It has to be returned before it can be corrected.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_VERSION_IMMUTABLE: A submitted request version cannot be changed. Returning the request opens a new version to correct it in.
problems.REQUEST_TRANSITION_INVALID: The request cannot move to that state.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_ENROLLMENT_MISMATCH: The chosen enrollment does not belong to this member or program.
problems.SERVICE_REQUEST_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE: A request number could not be allocated. Please try again.
problems.AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND: The authorization was not found, or it is not visible in this organization.
problems.AUTHORIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The authorization is no longer active: it may have expired, been used or been cancelled.
problems.AUTHORIZATION_ITEM_UNKNOWN: That line does not belong to this authorization.
problems.AUTHORIZATION_NO_APPROVED_ITEMS: The request has no approved lines, so there is nothing to authorize.
problems.AUTHORIZATION_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE: An authorization number could not be allocated. Please try again.
problems.REQUEST_NOT_APPROVED: A request cannot be authorized before it is approved.
problems.BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT: The remaining entitlement does not cover this.
problems.ENTITLEMENT_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The entitlement account was not found.
problems.ENTITLEMENT_ACCOUNT_CLOSED: The entitlement account is closed and takes no further movement.
problems.ENTITLEMENT_RESERVATION_CLOSED: That entitlement hold is closed and nothing more can be drawn from it.
problems.FULFILMENT_NOT_FOUND: The fulfilment record was not found.
problems.FULFILMENT_NOT_RECORDED: This fulfilment record cannot be acted on.
problems.FULFILMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETED: The fulfilment is complete; a correction is made with a reversing entry.
problems.OVER_FULFILMENT: What was delivered exceeds what the authorization has left.
problems.VOUCHER_ALREADY_ISSUED: This authorization already has a usable voucher.
problems.VOUCHER_ALREADY_REDEEMED: The voucher has already been used.
problems.VOUCHER_EXPIRED: The voucher is outside its validity window.
problems.WORK_QUEUE_NOT_FOUND: The work queue was not found, or it is not visible in this organization.
problems.WORK_QUEUE_CODE_TAKEN: That queue code is already in use.
problems.WORK_QUEUE_INACTIVE: The queue is closed; no new work can be raised into it.
problems.WORK_QUEUE_ESCALATION_CYCLE: A queue cannot escalate into itself.
problems.WORK_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: The work item was not found, or it is not visible in this organization.
problems.WORK_ITEM_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Somebody else has taken this work item. Refresh the list.
problems.WORK_ITEM_TRANSITION_INVALID: The work item cannot move to that state.
problems.WORK_ITEM_NOT_ASSIGNEE: You are not holding this work item; taking somebody else's work needs the reassign permission.
problems.APPROVAL_POLICY_OVERLAP: Another approval policy for this action and scope covers those dates.
problems.APPROVAL_POLICY_NOT_FOUND: No approval policy applies to this action and amount.
problems.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: The document was not found, or it is not visible in this organization.
problems.DOCUMENT_NOT_SCANNED: The document has not been virus scanned yet; it can be downloaded once the scan finishes.
problems.DOCUMENT_INFECTED: Malware was found in this document and the file was deleted. Upload a clean copy.
problems.DOCUMENT_PURGED: The document's retention period expired and the file was removed.
problems.DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_MISSING: No uploaded file was found. The upload link may not have been used, or it expired.
problems.DOCUMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This upload has already been completed.
problems.DOCUMENT_LINK_NOT_FOUND: The document link was not found.
problems.DOCUMENT_LINK_EXISTS: The document is already linked to that record under this type.
problems.DOCUMENT_LINK_PERMISSION_DENIED: Downloading this document needs an additional permission.
problems.DOCUMENT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The document store cannot be reached right now. Try again shortly.
problems.LEGAL_HOLD_NOT_FOUND: The legal hold was not found.
problems.LEGAL_HOLD_EXISTS: An active legal hold already covers that target.
problems.LEGAL_HOLD_ALREADY_RELEASED: The legal hold has already been released.
problems.NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: The notification template was not found.
problems.NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft template can be published.
problems.NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_IMMUTABLE: A published template cannot be changed; publish a new version.
problems.NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_MISSING: No template is published for that event, channel and language.
problems.NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE_NOT_RESENDABLE: That notification cannot be sent again.
problems.NOTIFICATION_RECIPIENT_OPTED_OUT: The recipient has turned this notification off.

fieldErrors.RULE_COMPILE_FAILED: The rule condition did not compile
fieldErrors.TESTS_REQUIRED: At least one test case is required
fieldErrors.DUPLICATE: The same value was given more than once
fieldErrors.IDENTIFIER_REQUIRED: A VKN or TCKN is required for Türkiye
fieldErrors.IDENTIFIER_CONFLICT: Only one VKN or TCKN is allowed
fieldErrors.VKN_INVALID: VKN must be 10 digits with a valid check digit
fieldErrors.TCKN_INVALID: TCKN must be 11 digits with valid check digits
fieldErrors.HEADER_INVALID: The header row does not match the expected columns
fieldErrors.DEPTH_EXCEEDED: The category tree may be at most six levels deep
fieldErrors.PERIOD: The end date must be after the start date
fieldErrors.NOT_FOUND: The selected record was not found
fieldErrors.MAX_ITEMS: Too many rows in one call
fieldErrors.PRIORITY_DUPLICATE: Another rule already uses this position

versions.submitConfirm: The version goes to review and can no longer be changed. Someone else approves publishing.
versions.publishConfirm: The version goes live. Entitlements from this date on are granted from it, and it can never be changed again.
versions.retireConfirm: The version is taken out of use. Entitlements already granted from it stay as they are.

imports.notAllowed: You are not allowed to import members.
